annotations.title: Duplicate one or more views with detailing (ViewDuplicateOpt

description: Duplicate one or more views with detailing (ViewDuplicateOption.WithDetailing keeps view-specific detailing/annotation), optionally renaming them and copying the crop region from the source view. Typical use: create the '高於6m牆標示' tall-partition markup views from a base plan.

copyCropFromSource.description: Copy the crop box / crop region from the source view onto the duplicate.

setActiveLast.description: Activate the last duplicated view when finished.

sourceViewIds.description: Source view ElementId(s) to duplicate. Accepts aliases 'viewIds' or a single 'sourceViewId'. Required (the tool errors if none resolve).

suffix.description: Name suffix appended when a target name is not supplied for a view.

targetNames.description: Optional new names for the duplicated views, positionally matched to sourceViewIds. Accepts aliases 'newNames' / 'targetName'.
